title: Java field declarations are not surfaced by code.items
wanted_capability: A code navigation surface that returns Java field declarations with name, type, modifiers, annotations, owner class, and span so agents do not have to write raw tree-sitter queries for routine field inspection.
missing_primitive: code.fields({ file }) or Java field_declaration support in code.items
fallback_used: The probe used raw code.query field_declaration patterns plus code.read/signature cross-checks.
notes: Genericized from a private Java refactor probe. The missing field surface added multiple avoidable code-mode cells and caused post-transform verification retries.
resolution_note: Implemented code.fields({ file, className? }) as a Java field declaration fact surface exposed through bro-harness/code_facts. It returns owner class, type, visibility, modifiers, annotations, static/final flags, and declaration/name spans without requiring raw tree-sitter field_declaration queries.
